entities.name: Idi Amin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leader of Uganda (1971–1979). Kakwa; military dictator; 'Butcher of Uganda'; expelled Asians 1972; estimated 100,000-500,000 killed; overthrown by Tanzanian invasion (Kagera War); died in Saudi exile 2003
